blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Over 150 photographs by 46 visual journalists are currently on view at Kapitolyo Art Space in Pasig City. The exhibition titled “Solace” showcases photographs from the Philippines, India, Mongolia, and beyond. The images reveal Asia’s struggles, from the fight for democracy in camps to how average citizens navigate environmental crises to survive, and how, in between these challenges, tenderness shines amid adversity. Documentary photographer and educator Veejay Villafranca curated Solace.
